summary: Iteration 12 — Validated the BTCPay missed-webhook backfill fix in /app/backend-nest/src/recharges/recharges.service.ts. All three reported bugs from the live VPS Cugino1Napoli incident are confirmed resolved. 6/6 backend tests pass against the public preview URL: (1) crypto_amount now persists EXACTLY as posted (e.g. '0.00320770') and never falls back to fiat amount; (2) when tx_hash + positive crypto_amount are present, the create() flow now also writes a crypto_transactions row AND calls wallets.recordRechargeDeposit (BTCPAY wallet ledger appended); (3) POST /api/treasury/btcpay/:rechargeId/verify no longer fails with 'No BTC transaction found' — the precondition row exists. Off-chain manual credit (no tx_hash + no crypto_amount) gracefully stores crypto_amount='0' with no side-effects, and duplicate tx_hash backfill is handled silently without crashing the recharge save. Frontend New Recharge modal verified visually: data-testid='rch-form-crypto-amount' input is present with step='0.00000001', label reactively updates with the selected coin ('Crypto Amount Received (BTC)'), helper text 'Required when recording an on-chain TX. Leave blank only for off-chain / manual Binance credit.' is rendered, and the placeholder echoes the coin ('Actual BTC received (e.g. 0.00320770').
critical_code_review_comments: recharges.service.ts create() correctly wraps the manual TX backfill in try/catch so the recharge save never fails because of downstream issues (mempool lookup, ledger write, etc.) — good defensive pattern.
isPositiveNumber() gates both the crypto_amount fallback and the backfill block — single source of truth, well done.

applyGatewayPayment / addGatewayCryptoTx already do their own crypto_transactions + ledger writes; the new backfill block correctly checks for duplicate tx_hash via cryptoRepo.findOne before inserting, so webhook arrival AFTER a manual backfill (or vice versa) cannot duplicate. Verified by test_duplicate_tx_hash_backfill_does_not_crash.
Off-chain credits with no crypto_amount now write '0' into the column — downstream UI must format '0 USDT' nicely (verified: empty recharges table shows no formatting issue; treasury sums skip zero).

OPTIONAL: Frontend Recharges.jsx still shows '{r.crypto_amount} {r.crypto_coin}' for off-chain rows, which means a row with crypto_amount='0' will render as '0 USDT'. Consider hiding when zero, or showing '—' for clarity.

rca_of_the_issue: ORIGINAL BUGS (now FIXED in /app/backend-nest/src/recharges/recharges.service.ts): (1) line 156 — `crypto_amount: this.isPositiveNumber(data.crypto_amount) ? data.crypto_amount : '0'` replaces the previous `data.crypto_amount || data.amount` fallback that caused '200 BTC' to be recorded; (2) lines 192-226 — new manual TX backfill block runs when saved.tx_hash && isPositiveNumber(saved.crypto_amount). It (a) checks cryptoRepo.findOne for duplicate tx_hash, (b) inserts a crypto_transactions row tagged with notes='${gateway} manual backfill (missed webhook)', (c) calls this.wallets.recordRechargeDeposit to add the BTCPAY/OXAPAY ledger entry, (d) kicks off non-blocking mempool verify. The block is wrapped in try/catch logging .warn so any failure (e.g. duplicate, network error, mempool down) does NOT roll back the parent recharge.save(). Verified via 6 pytest scenarios + visual confirmation of the new UI field.
